The product

The Giarratana onion

Slow Food Presidium

The Giarratana onion, from the Sicilian town in the province of Ragusa, is a Slow Food Presidium.

Large and sweet

It has very large bulbs, which can exceed a kilo, and a sweet, delicate flavour.

In the kitchen

It suits salads, roasting and stuffing.
